You deposit: 1 ETH as collateral, worth 2,000 USDC
Protocol's max LTV (loan-to-value) for ETH: 75%

Maximum you can borrow: 2,000 * 0.75 = 1,500 USDC

You choose to actually borrow: 1,000 USDC
(below the max, for a safety margin)
caption: Max LTV is a per-asset risk parameter -- volatile assets get a lower ceiling.

code:
Health factor = (collateral value * liquidation threshold)
                / borrowed value

Liquidation threshold: 80% (slightly above the 75% max-LTV)

Health factor = (2,000 * 0.80) / 1,000 = 1.60
caption: A single number anyone can verify on-chain -- no credit check required.
